args.command:
cd /bench/repo && cat > /tmp/scoped.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
ALL=$(find . -name '*.go' ! -path './web/*' ! -path './.git/*')
# decls: name|dir
find internal -name '*.go' ! -name '*_test.go' | while read -r f; do
  d=$(dirname "$f")
  grep -hoE '^func (\([^)]*\) )?[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\(' "$f" \
    | sed -E 's/^func (\([^)]*\) )?//; s/\($//' \
    | while read -r n; do echo "$n|$d"; done
done | sort -u | grep -vE '^(init|main)\|' > /tmp/decls.txt
wc -l < /tmp/decls.txt
while IFS='|' read -r n d; do
  if [[ "$n" =~ ^[A-Z] ]]; then SCOPE="$ALL"; else SCOPE=$(ls $d/*.go 2>/dev/null); fi
  [ -z "$SCOPE" ] && continue
  hits=$(grep -hE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])${n}\(" $SCOPE 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "^func " | grep -oE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])${n}\(" | wc -l)
  nt=$(grep -hE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])${n}\(" $(echo "$SCOPE" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -v '_test.go' | tr '\n' ' ') 2>/dev/null | grep -vE "^func " | grep -oE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])${n}\(" | wc -l)
  echo "$nt $hits $n $d"
done < /tmp/decls.txt | sort -rn > /tmp/scoped_out.txt
head -45 /tmp/scoped_out.txt
SH
bash /tmp/scoped.sh
